test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 05 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it seems to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the statements.

Statements:

All figs are bananas.

All cups are bananas.

Conclusions:

(I) Some figs are cups.

(II) All cups are figs.
solution:
Statements:
All figs are bananas.
All cups are bananas.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/609b953626d4d4875af10392d693c3838329d7c892d2e1469d49562af7383165.png] 

Conclusions:
(I) Some figs are cups. - False (There is no definite relation between figs and cups, it can be possible but it is not definite.)
(II) All cups are figs. - False (There is no definite relation between figs and cups, it can be possible but it is not definite.)

Thus, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.
Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
